mapper.sql: id, member_id, activity_id, topic_id, node_id, node_lat, node_lng, accuracy_m, verdict, reason_code, detail, created_at
mapper.insert: insert into play_arrive_guard_log (member_id, activity_id, topic_id, node_id, node_lat, node_lng, accuracy_m, verdict, reason_code, detail, created_at) values (#{memberId}, #{activityId}, #{topicId}, #{nodeId}, #{nodeLat}, #{nodeLng}, #{accuracyM}, #{verdict}, #{reasonCode}, #{detail}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select from play_arrive_guard_log where member_id = #{memberId} and (reason_code is null or reason_code <> 'ARRIVE_GUARD_THROTTLE') order by created_at desc, id desc limit 1
select from play_arrive_guard_log where member_id = #{memberId} and verdict in ('PASS', 'SHADOW') order by created_at desc, id desc limit 1
